I’d like to exchange the bicycle for a larger frame size for my kid, and swap the jigsaw puzzle for one with the same difficulty but with 1000 more pieces—if possible, I’d prefer an animal theme over art. Also, I want to exchange the camera for a slightly lower resolution, but keep the other features the same.

And in a different order, I’d like to cancel the skateboard. Can you help me with all of that?
Sure! My name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260. I actually don’t remember which email I used for the order, but hopefully my name and zip code will be enough.

And for the skateboard cancellation, the reason is “no longer needed.”

One more thing: for any refunds or payments, I’d prefer to use the other card on file if possible.

- For the bicycle, I’ll go with the large frame size, red, mountain type (item id: 5606522780).

- For the camera, I’ll choose the 20MP resolution, 5x zoom, CF card storage (item id: 9644439410).

And yes, please use credit_card_3951670 for any payments or refunds related to these exchanges and the skateboard cancellation.

Let me know if you need anything else from me!
Yes, everything looks correct! Please go ahead and proceed with all of those changes and use credit_card_3951670 for any payments or refunds. Thank you for double-checking!

Great, thanks for your help! That covers everything I needed today. Have a good one!
